title: Unitarity dressing of the dynamical gluon mass scale
summary: We examine how $s$-channel unitarization changes the dynamical gluon mass scale $m_g$ inferred from high-energy elastic $pp$ scattering. The Born input is the Reggeized Landshoff--Nachtmann exchange of two nonperturbative gluons in a color-singlet state. We fit the ATLAS and TOTEM forward data separately, using eikonal and $U$-matrix unitarizations with logarithmic and power-law running masses derived from Schwinger--Dyson analyses.
